# TSBS DevOps — Last Point per Host

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Most recent metrics for each host

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT c.hostname, c.time, c.usage_user, c.usage_system, c.usage_idle
FROM cpu c
JOIN (
    SELECT hostname, MAX(time) AS max_time
    FROM cpu
    WHERE time >= '2024-01-01 12:00:00'
    GROUP BY hostname
) latest ON c.hostname = latest.hostname AND c.time = latest.max_time
WHERE c.time >= '2024-01-01 12:00:00'
ORDER BY c.hostname
```
